claim: If and only if the final qualification record is PASS and its lock verifies, WP2KSQ-v1 qualifies the declared canonical Kustaanheimo-Stiefel construction for isolated negative-energy Kepler motion: the Hopf position map, canonical cotangent lift, common-phase S1 action, Xi momentum map, zero-level quotient, fixed-energy Sundman rule dt/ds=|u|^2, regular four-dimensional isotropic oscillator, physical-time reconstruction, and smooth radial-collision passage in regular variables. Within the frozen corpus bounds, projected collision-free trajectories reproduce independently encoded analytic Kepler conics and the external REBOUND IAS15 implementation at the declared checkpoints.
evidence_boundary: This qualification is limited to an isolated two-body Hamiltonian with reduced_mass>0, kappa>0, fixed E<0, Xi=0, elliptic eccentricity 0<=e<=0.97, the parameter ranges in the frozen corpus, and the explicitly tested radial-collision continuation. It does not qualify E>=0, nonzero-Xi magnetic reduction, perturbed Kepler motion, a pair embedded in a three-body field, pairwise or simultaneous three-body KS, full three-body reduction, orbit discovery, additional first integrals, or any WP3/WP4 claim.

model.quotient: Xi^-1(0)/S1 is represented by the physical Kepler phase state away from collision

splits.holdout: Reserved inputs whose outputs must not exist before lock verification

independent_references.analytic: Validation-side elliptic Kepler solver using eccentric anomaly and independent orbital-element rotations; it imports no production KS code.
independent_references.external: REBOUND IAS15 Cartesian two-body propagation with the central mass fixed at the origin; it imports no production KS code.

published_foundations.title: Reduction and regularization of the Kepler problem
published_foundations.author: J. C. van der Meer

published_foundations.title: On the regularization of the Kepler problem
published_foundations.author: M. Kummer

execution.holdout_rule: The holdout runner verifies every frozen file hash before selecting holdout cases. A failed holdout remains FAIL and requires a new campaign version.

downstream_policy: This PASS is necessary but insufficient for full three-body reduction or pairwise KS. Those paths may be rebuilt only when this record and WP1Q-N3BP-v1 are both PASS with valid locks, and the rebuilt path must then satisfy its own downstream qualification.
